data.title: What Bitmine’s Ethereum Buying Cap Could Mean For BMNR Stock
data.description: Bitmine Immersion Technologies reported full year 2026 revenue of US$124.81 million and a net loss of US$6,313.39 million, while continuing to accumulate Ethereum to nearly 5% of the token's total supply and staking most of these holdings through its MAVAN validator network. Management has flagged an end to Ethereum purchases once the 5% ownership cap is reached. This shift could free future cash and equity issuance capacity for uses such as potential share buybacks and may raise sharper...
